expectations.text: States the January 2025 AI Diffusion IFR was never formally rescinded in the Federal Register
expectations.evidence: "the rule was never repealed on the books... the January 2025 IFR remains technically in effect"

expectations.text: Notes BIS announced non-enforcement/intent to rescind in May 2025
expectations.evidence: "May 2025 — non-enforcement announcement... BIS announced it would not enforce the rule"

expectations.text: Cites GAO decision B-337935: the non-enforcement announcement is itself a CRA 'rule' that was not submitted to Congress
expectations.evidence: "GAO decision (B-337935)... held that the May 2025 non-enforcement announcement itself constituted a 'rule' for purposes of the Congressional Review Act... BIS had not submitted it to Congress"

expectations.text: States the operative successor approach: country-specific rules (e.g., the July 2026 UAE advanced-chip rule, 91 FR 43034) rather than a global framework
expectations.evidence: "BIS has moved to country-specific rulemaking... The clearest example is the UAE rule (91 FR 43034)"

expectations.text: Advises: do not structure around a 'replacement diffusion framework' that does not exist; apply current ECCN 3A090/4A090-family controls, license policies, and end-user rules, and monitor BIS
expectations.evidence: "Do not build licensing workflows... around the January 2025 diffusion tiers... Continue to apply... 3A090/4A090 classification... Monitor the Federal Register"
